objective: Compute the critical clearing angle and critical clearing time for a single-machine-infinite-bus fault using the equal-area criterion.

title.en: REL-TASK-048 — Critical clearing time via the equal-area criterion
title.ru: REL-TASK-048 — Критическое время отключения по критерию равных площадей

objective.en: Compute the critical clearing angle and critical clearing time for a single-machine-infinite-bus fault using the equal-area criterion.
objective.ru: Рассчитать критический угол и критическое время отключения КЗ для схемы машина — шины бесконечной мощности по критерию равных площадей.

instructions.en: Use smib_cct_case. Power transfer is zero during the fault. Compute delta0 = asin(Pm/prefault_pmax), delta_max = pi - asin(Pm/postfault_pmax), the critical clearing angle from the equal-area criterion cos(delta_cr) = (Pm*(delta_max - delta0) + postfault_pmax*cos(delta_max)) / postfault_pmax, and the critical clearing time t_cr = sqrt(4*H*(delta_cr - delta0) / (2*pi*f0*Pm)). Report angles in degrees and time in seconds. Do not copy an expected answer; derive all values from the case data.
instructions.ru: Используйте smib_cct_case. Во время КЗ передача мощности равна нулю. Вычислите delta0 = asin(Pm/prefault_pmax), delta_max = pi - asin(Pm/postfault_pmax), критический угол отключения из критерия равных площадей cos(delta_cr) = (Pm*(delta_max - delta0) + postfault_pmax*cos(delta_max)) / postfault_pmax и критическое время отключения t_cr = sqrt(4*H*(delta_cr - delta0) / (2*pi*f0*Pm)). Укажите углы в градусах, время в секундах. Не копируйте ожидаемый ответ; выведите все значения из данных кейса.

smib_cct_case.fault_description: Bolted three-phase fault at the generator HV terminals; cleared by tripping one of two parallel tie lines, which lowers the post-fault transfer capability.
Bolted three-phase fault at the generator HV terminals; cleared by tripping one of two parallel tie lines, which lowers the post-fault transfer capability.

submission_schema.delta_max_deg: maximum post-fault angle preserving stability, in degrees
submission_schema.delta_critical_deg: critical clearing angle from the equal-area criterion, in degrees

hard_constraints: All four numeric fields must be present and match the recomputed equal-area study (angles within 0.01 deg, time within 0.001 s).
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.
Optional rationale text is ignored by the deterministic evaluator.
